name: E Prathyush Kumar

education.institution: St. Aloysius (Deemed to be University), Mangaluru

summary: I'm an Information Science and Engineering student at St. Aloysius. I build small Python and Flask tools, work on web projects, and am interested in joining hackathon teams across backend and frontend development.

projects.title: File Universal — Document Utility
projects.description: A clean, private web utility for converting Word to PDF, PDF to Word, merging, and compressing documents. Built with Python and Flask.
projects.purpose: Local document conversion and compression utility without third-party file uploads.
projects.problem: Public online converters often impose strict file limits, expose sensitive documents, and clutter the experience with ads.

projects.title: Lectures Website (Planned Concept)
projects.description: Planned concept for a central place to organize lecture notes and course resources so students can find study materials more easily.
projects.purpose: Proposed concept for a centralized lecture-resource website.
projects.problem: Course materials are usually scattered across chat groups and expired cloud links before semester examinations.

projects.title: Personal Resume Website
projects.description: A lightweight personal portfolio and printable resume designed to document coursework, projects, and technical skills.
projects.purpose: Fast, accessible developer portfolio with dark theme support and print stylesheet.
projects.problem: Standard developer templates rely on heavy UI libraries and look generic rather than representing authentic individual work.

hackathon_interest: Web and software development. Interested in building working prototypes, Python backends, or clean responsive frontends in a team setting.
